given: A large repo is mid-index: some files failed to parse and the graph smoke check hasn't passed, so Readiness is not_ready with named gaps.
when: Someone tries to bring Proxy into a meeting and asks a code question before the index is ready.
then: The connect page renders the not_ready terminal state naming the gaps (never a silent partial join), and if asked in-meeting Proxy says what it cannot see (Law 1, grounded-or-silent) rather than giving a confident wrong answer.
